title: PHPC enters BSP regulatory sandbox testing
description: BSP approval and public reporting placed PHPC into controlled regulatory sandbox testing for a Philippine-peso-backed stablecoin pilot with reserve and real-world usage evaluation requirements.
notes: The event date uses the dated public report of the BSP-approved pilot; the official PHPC whitepaper remains the primary product and sandbox terms source.

title: PHPC launches on Ronin
description: Ronin announced PHPC live on the network and published the exact PHPC token address for wallet import and ecosystem use.
notes: This is a network deployment launch, not proof of PHPC's original first issuance day.

title: StraitsX launches XIDR
description: StraitsX officially released XIDR and the StraitsX Indonesia platform, describing 1:1 IDR backing and verified-user acquisition through the platform.
notes: Official launch announcement date is used as the canonical XIDR launch date.
